### How to Be Ready for Anything and Laugh at Days to Come
Author: Kathi Lipp
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-june-10-2020.html
Passage: Proverbs 31:25
Points:
- The Proverbs 31 woman's diligence was meant to serve others, not induce guilt or inadequacy.
- Failing to prepare often reflects fear of the future rather than real reliance on God.
- Intentional preparation and wisdom allow a person to face the days ahead without panic.
- Peace comes from handling what we can control while entrusting uncontrollable circumstances to God.

### Who Really Signs Your Check?
Author: Mary Southerland
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-september-17-2019.html
Passage: Proverbs 31:13
Points:
- Personal attitude determines whether our daily labor feels like drudgery or brings satisfaction.
- The Proverbs 31 woman deliberately chose an enthusiastic, eager disposition toward her responsibilities.
- Ordinary tasks gain lasting value when performed as an offering of worship to God.
- Even under difficult circumstances, believers can work diligently knowing Christ is their ultimate provider.

### You Are Worth Celebrating
Author: Lysa TerKeurst
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-july-9-2026.html
Passage: Proverbs 31:30
Points:
- Proverbs 31 was intended as an affirmation to celebrate women rather than a standard of condemnation.
- The biblical term describes a courageous woman of valor facing hard realities with dignity.
- Lasting value does not depend on domestic perfection, marital status, or fleeting physical charms.
- A heart rooted in reverence and trust toward God is the true source of wisdom and praise.

### The Wife Who Is to Be Praised
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/wife-who-be-praised
Passage: Proverbs 31:28-31
Points:
- Loving praise from family and community is the rightful response to a noble woman's service.
- Physical charm and outward beauty fade, whereas a life grounded in the fear of the Lord endures.
- Godly spouses recognize and cherish spiritual character above all external qualities.
- Honoring the faithful virtues of a spouse ultimately gives praise and glory to God.
